questions.stem: A sum of money at simple interest amounts to \( \text{Rs. } 815 \) in \( 3 \) years and to \( \text{Rs. } 854 \) in \( 4 \) years. Find the rate percent per annum (correct to one decimal place).
A certain sum is invested at simple interest of \( 12\% \) per annum. If the amount becomes four times the principal, find the time period.
A sum of money invested at simple interest triples itself in \( 8 \) years. In how many years will it become \( 6 \) times of itself?
questions.keySolution:
Tripling in \( 8 \) yr \Rightarrow \text{SI} = 2P \) in \( 8 \) yr
Rate = \( 25\% \) p.a.
To make amount \( 6P \Rightarrow \text{SI} = 5P \)
\( T = \frac{5P \times 100}{P \times 25} = 20 \text{ yr} \)

questions.stem: The simple interest on a certain sum for \( 2 \) years at \( 8\% \) per annum is \( \text{Rs. } 240 \). What will be the simple interest on the same sum for \( 5 \) years at \( 6\% \) per annum?

A sum of \( \text{Rs. } 25000 \) becomes \( \text{Rs. } 31000 \) in \( 48 \) months at simple interest. How long (from the beginning) will the same sum take to amount to \( \text{Rs. } 37000 \) at the same rate?
At what rate percent per annum will a sum of money double itself in \( 12 \) years at simple interest?
The simple interest on \( \text{Rs. } 500 \) for \( 3 \) years is \( \text{Rs. } 75 \). What will be the simple interest on the same sum for \( 7 \) years at the same rate?

A certain sum amounts to \( \text{Rs. } 1260 \) in \( 2 \) years and \( \text{Rs. } 1350 \) in \( 5 \) years at simple interest. In how many years from the start will it amount to \( \text{Rs. } 1440 \)?
questions.keySolution:
SI per year = \( \frac{1350-1260}{5-2} = \text{Rs. } 30 \)
Principal = \( 1260 - 2 \times 30 = \text{Rs. } 1200 \)
\( 1440-1200 = 240 \Rightarrow T = 240/30 = 8 \text{ yr} \)

questions.stem: If a sum of money becomes \( 3 \) times in \( 10 \) years at simple interest, in how many years will it become \( 5 \) times?
questions.keySolution:
SI per year = \( 2P/10 = P/5 \)
To get \( 4P \) interest: \( T = 4P/(P/5) = 20 \text{ yr} \)

questions.stem: The difference between the simple interest for \( 6 \) years and \( 4 \) years on \( \text{Rs. } 2000 \) at \( 12\% \) per annum is:

A sum of money lends at simple interest amounts to \( \text{Rs. } 3224 \) in \( 2 \) years and \( \text{Rs. } 4160 \) in \( 5 \) years. Find the time (from the beginning) in which it will amount to \( \text{Rs. } 5408 \).
questions.keySolution:
SI per year = \( \frac{4160-3224}{5-2} = \text{Rs. } 312 \)
Principal = \( 3224 - 2 \times 312 = \text{Rs. } 2600 \)
Needed SI = \( 5408-2600 = 2808 \Rightarrow T = 2808/312 = 9 \text{ yr} \)

questions.stem: The simple interest on \( \text{Rs. } 900 \) in \( 2 \) years is \( \tfrac{1}{5} \) of the principal. What will be the simple interest on the same principal in \( 7 \) years at the same rate?
A certain sum doubles itself in \( 8 \) years at simple interest. In how many years will it triple itself?
questions.keySolution:
SI per year = \( P/8 \)
To get \( 2P \) interest: \( T = 2P/(P/8) = 16 \text{ yr} \)

questions.stem: The simple interest on a certain sum for \( 15 \) months at \( 8\% \) p.a. exceeds the simple interest on the same sum for \( 8 \) months at \( 12\% \) p.a. by \( \text{Rs. } 90 \). Find the principal.
questions.keySolution:
Time \( T_1 = 1.25 \text{ yr},\; T_2 = 0.666\text{ yr} \)
Difference in SI: \( P \times 8 \times 1.25/100 - P \times 12 \times 0.666/100 = 90 \)
\( 0.10P - 0.08P = 90 \Rightarrow 0.02P = 90 \Rightarrow P = \text{Rs. } 4500 \)

questions.stem: If \( \text{Rs. } 1200 \) amounts to \( \text{Rs. } 1632 \) in \( 3 \) years at simple interest, how many years will \( \text{Rs. } 2000 \) take to amount to \( \text{Rs. } 3200 \) at the same rate?
A sum becomes \( \tfrac{8}{5} \) times itself in \( 6 \) years at simple interest. In how many years will it become \( \tfrac{13}{5} \) times itself?
questions.keySolution:
SI per year = \( (3P/5)/6 = P/10 \)
Required SI = \( 8P/5 \Rightarrow T = (8P/5)/(P/10)=16 \text{ yr} \)

questions.stem: The simple interest on \( \text{Rs. } P \) for \( 3 \) years at \( R\% \) p.a. is \( \text{Rs. } 360 \). What will be the simple interest on \( 2P \) for \( 5 \) years at \( \tfrac{R}{2}\% \) p.a.?

A certain sum amounts to \( \text{Rs. } 7200 \) in \( 2 \) years and \( \text{Rs. } 7680 \) in \( 3 \) years at simple interest. In how many years (from the start) will it amount to \( \text{Rs. } 9120 \)?
questions.keySolution:
SI per year = \( 7680-7200 = 480 \)
Principal = \( 7200 - 2 \times 480 = 6240 \)
Additional SI needed = \( 9120-6240 = 2880 \Rightarrow T = 2880/480 = 6 \text{ yr} \)

questions.stem: At simple interest, a sum becomes \( \text{Rs. } 2205 \) in \( 3 \) years and \( \text{Rs. } 2500 \) in \( 5 \) years. In which year (from the start) will it amount to \( \text{Rs. } 3090 \)?
If the simple interest on \( \text{Re. } 1 \) for \( 1 \) month is \( 1 \) paisa, then the rate percent per annum is:
A sum becomes \( \tfrac{9}{8} \) times itself in \( \tfrac{3}{2} \) years at simple interest. In how many years will it become \( \tfrac{3}{2} \) times itself?
questions.keySolution:
SI per yr = \( (P/8)/(3/2) = P/12 \)
Required SI = \( P/2 \Rightarrow T = 6 \text{ yr} \)

questions.stem: The ratio of simple interest earned in \( 8 \) years to that earned in \( 12 \) years on the same principal is \( 4:7 \). If the SI for \( 8 \) years is \( \text{Rs. } 800 \), find the principal.
questions.keySolution:
SI per yr = \( 800/8 = 100 \)
Rate \( R = \frac{100 \times 100}{P} \Rightarrow P = 4000 \)

questions.stem: A sum earns \( \text{Rs. } 1800 \) as simple interest in \( 4.5 \) years at \( 8\% \) p.a. Find the simple interest on the same principal for \( 6.25 \) years at \( 12\% \) p.a.
If the simple interest for \( 3 \) years is \( \tfrac{3}{8} \) of the principal, then in how many years will the simple interest be equal to half of the principal?
questions.keySolution:
SI per yr = \( (3P/8)/3 = P/8 \);
Need SI = \( P/2 \Rightarrow T = (P/2)/(P/8)=4 \text{ yr} \)

questions.stem: A principal of \( \text{Rs. } 4000 \) amounts to \( \text{Rs. } 6800 \) at simple interest in how many years, given it becomes \( \text{Rs. } 5200 \) after \( 3 \) years?
The simple interest on a sum for \( 5 \) years is one-fourth of the principal. In how many years will the simple interest be half of the principal at the same rate?
questions.keySolution:
SI per yr = \( (P/4)/5 = P/20 \);
Need SI = \( P/2 \Rightarrow T = (P/2)/(P/20)=10 \text{ yr} \)

questions.stem: A sum of money amounts to \( \text{Rs. } 2240 \) in \( 2 \) years and to \( \text{Rs. } 2600 \) in \( 5 \) years at simple interest. After how many years from the beginning will it amount to \( \text{Rs. } 3320 \)?
At what rate percent per annum will \( \text{Rs. } 3000 \) amount to \( \text{Rs. } 3993 \) in \( 3 \) years \( 3 \) months at simple interest?
A sum becomes \( \tfrac{7}{4} \) times itself in \( 6 \) years at simple interest. In how many years will it become \( \tfrac{5}{2} \) times itself?
questions.keySolution:
SI per yr = \( (3P/4)/6 = P/8 \);
Needed SI = \( 3P/2 \Rightarrow T = (3P/2)/(P/8)=12 \text{ yr} \)

questions.stem: Simple interest on a certain sum at \( 6\% \) p.a. for \( 4 \) years is \( \text{Rs. } 240 \) more than the SI on the same sum at \( 4\% \) p.a. for \( 5 \) years. Find the sum.
The difference between the simple interest received from two different banks on \( \text{Rs. } 500 \) for \( 2 \) years is \( \text{Rs. } 2.50 \). Find the difference between their rates.

Out of \( \text{Rs. } 10000 \), a part is lent at \( 8\% \) p.a. and the rest at \( 6\% \) p.a., both for \( 4 \) years at simple interest. If the total interest is \( \text{Rs. } 2880 \), find the sum lent at \( 8\% \).
